newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Coast gets first Canadair jet.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Coast gets first Canadair jet.

text.p: Atlantic Coast Airlines Inc said Friday that it has taken delivery of the first of 12 new series 200 ER 50-seat Canadair Regional Jets, acquired in January from Bombardier Regional Aircraft Co.
The company said three more of the planes are scheduled for delivery to in 1997 and eight more in 1998. Atlantic Coast also said it holds an option for 36 additional aircraft.
Jet service is scheduled to begin in the fall, but the company said specific routes for the fleet have yet to be announced.
The Canadair Jet is a twin-engine aircraft designed to serve medium-range and small markets, said the company.
Atlantic Coast Airlines had revenues of $182.5 million in 1996 and operates about 450 daily departures serving 41 destinations in 17 states.
